Zixlabs SQC · Steam Quality Calculator

Privacy policy.

How Zixlab Ltd handles information in Zixlabs SQC on iOS, iPadOS and Android, including paid app-store purchases.

Current policy

On-device by design

SQC is designed to perform steam-quality calculations and generate test reports on the user's device. Zixlab Ltd does not operate a cloud backend that receives users' steam-quality test inputs or generated reports.

Effective date
22 November 2026
Application
Zixlabs SQC (paid edition)
Publisher
Zixlab Ltd
App identifier
uk.co.zixlab.sqc

1. Who we are

Zixlabs SQC (the separately purchased SQC Pro application; "SQC", "the app") is a Steam Quality Calculator developed and published by Zixlab Ltd, company number 17433963, registered in England and Wales. Zixlab Ltd is the controller of personal data we process in connection with support, administration and operation of this application.

Zixlab Ltd
Registered office: 8 Telford Avenue, Ellesmere, Shropshire SY12 0GE, United Kingdom.
Privacy contact: hello@zixlab.co.uk.

2. Scope and platforms

This policy applies to the standalone paid Zixlabs SQC app on iOS, iPadOS and Android, and to support or privacy enquiries about that app. Its application identifier is uk.co.zixlab.sqc.

The free ZX SQC Lite app with an optional lifetime Pro upgrade is a different application and has a separate privacy policy, including details of its RevenueCat purchase verification. This paid SQC app does not require the Lite upgrade to be purchased.

Apple App Store, Google Play, device providers, employers and any services used to save or share reports have their own applicable terms and privacy practices.

3. Information entered into SQC

You may enter test measurements, equipment-under-test information, identifiers, dates, performed-by names, repeat-test information and other report details. The app uses the information to calculate non-condensable gas, dryness value and superheat results and present the configured assessments and report content.

Enter only information you are authorised to use, and follow your organisation's procedures for handling workplace and personal information.

4. Calculations and PDF reports

Core calculations and PDF report generation take place on the device. Zixlab Ltd does not operate a cloud calculation service or a backend that receives your steam-quality test inputs, calculated results or generated PDF reports.

Generated reports may include the measurements, results, names, equipment identifiers and other information you enter. These reports remain under your control unless you choose to save or share them elsewhere.

5. Saving, exporting and sharing reports

When you save, export, print or share a report, the destination and transfer are controlled by your device and the provider you select, such as email, cloud storage or organisational systems. Those providers process shared data according to their own privacy terms. Zixlab Ltd does not receive a copy merely because you use device sharing controls.

6. Accounts, support and contact information

A Zixlab account is not required for the app's calculation and reporting features. If you contact us for support or a privacy request, we receive information you choose to provide, such as an email address, correspondence, diagnostic details or attachments. We use it to respond to the request, provide support and protect our legitimate business and legal interests.

7. Apple App Store and Google Play purchases

Zixlabs SQC is purchased as a paid application through Apple App Store on iOS/iPadOS or Google Play on Android. The relevant store processes the purchase, payment method, download and store-account records under its own policies. This standalone paid application is distinct from the optional RevenueCat-managed in-app upgrade offered in SQC Lite.

Apple and Google may provide us with sales, financial and transaction reporting necessary to administer sales, taxes, refunds, support and marketplace obligations. We do not receive full payment-card details or your store-account password through the app. Store providers may also process device, diagnostic and installation information independently of Zixlab Ltd.

See Apple App Store privacy information and the Google Privacy Policy.

8. Network services, analytics and advertising

The app's core calculation and reporting workflow does not require a Zixlab-hosted service. The app does not display advertising, and we do not sell users' personal information or use steam-quality test inputs or PDF contents for advertising.

Operating systems, app stores and third-party software components may process limited technical, installation, security or diagnostic information under their own terms. Where applicable, the relevant App Store privacy and Google Play Data Safety declarations should reflect information processed through the application and its included components.

9. Purposes and legal bases

Where UK data-protection law applies, we use support and related information where necessary to fulfil contractual requests, pursue legitimate interests in providing support and protecting security or legal rights, and meet legal obligations such as accounting or tax record-keeping. The applicable basis depends on the purpose and context. Where separate consent is required, we will seek it.

10. Sharing, international processing and security

We may share support or administrative information with service providers and professional advisers when reasonably necessary, subject to appropriate safeguards, or where required by law. Apple and Google may process store-related information internationally under their own privacy arrangements. Where personal information is transferred internationally on our behalf, appropriate lawful safeguards apply where required.

We use reasonable technical and organisational safeguards appropriate to the information handled. Please protect your device and reports with appropriate access controls and your organisation's procedures. No electronic system is completely secure.

11. Retention and deletion

Test inputs and PDFs held locally or exported to destinations you select are managed through your device and chosen storage or sharing services. Uninstalling the app may remove its local data but does not remove copies previously exported or saved elsewhere.

Support correspondence and administrative records held by Zixlab Ltd are kept only as long as reasonably necessary to handle enquiries, protect legitimate interests and meet applicable legal obligations. Apple and Google separately manage their own account, purchase and transaction records. Contact us if you wish to exercise applicable rights over data processed by Zixlab Ltd.

12. Professional and workplace use

SQC is an engineering and quality-support utility and does not replace approved procedures, calibrated equipment, qualified personnel, formal validation or independent verification. Organisations managing devices may apply their own privacy, security, mobile-device-management, backup and retention rules.

13. Children and data-protection rights

The app is intended for professional use and is not directed at children. Zixlab Ltd does not knowingly design it to collect personal information from children.

Depending on the circumstances, UK data-protection law may give you rights to access, correct or erase personal data, restrict or object to its processing, and receive certain data in a portable format. You may contact hello@zixlab.co.uk to exercise applicable rights, and complain to the UK Information Commissioner's Office if you believe your rights have been infringed.

14. Changes to this policy

We may revise this policy when app functionality, service providers, applicable requirements or information-handling practices change. The latest version will be published at this URL with an updated effective date.
